def __init__(self, width=512, blocks=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.joint_enc = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(3, 32), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(32, 32))
        self.inp = nn.Linear(51 + 17 * 32 + 3 + 64, width)
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[Block(width) for _ in range(blocks)])
        self.out = nn.Linear(width, 51)

    def forward(self, x, t, c):
        kp = c[:, :34].reshape(-1, 17, 2)
        m = c[:, 34:51].unsqueeze(-1)
        fr = c[:, 51:]
        jf = self.joint_enc(torch.cat([kp, m], dim=-1)).reshape(-1, 17 * 32)
        h = torch.cat([x, jf, fr, sinusoidal(t)], dim=1)
        return self.out(self.blocks(self.inp(h)))

def __init__(self, width=512, blocks=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.inp = nn.Linear(51 + 64, width)
        self.cmlp = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(54, width), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(width, width * 2))
        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*[Block(width) for _ in range(blocks)])
        self.out = nn.Linear(width, 51)

    def forward(self, x, t, c):
        h = torch.cat([x, sinusoidal(t)], dim=1)
        h = self.inp(h)
        g, b = self.cmlp(c).chunk(2, dim=1)
        h = h * (1 + g) + b
        return self.out(self.blocks(h))
